name: MSC Gayane crew member (convicted; silhouette only)
depiction: One of the eight MSC Gayane crew members who pleaded guilty in federal court in Philadelphia to the 2019 conspiracy (cocaine loaded at sea with the ship's crane) and were sentenced. Represents the crew generically, not one identified person. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette (silhouette option): no face, no features; plain dark work jacket. Never named. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS.
